entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Path too long in TemplateEngine.Orchestrator.RunnableProjects.UnitTests #55809
  • publish (trimmed): same command, different outputs #55808
  • dotnetup in offline/air-gapped environments #55803

Closed

  • dotnetup creates ~/.bash_profile that shadows ~/.profile, silently breaking login-shell PATH #55700
  • ResolvePackageAssets target is skipped for multiple target frameworks and Rebuild target in 17.2.0 #26864
    Backlog
  • NetCore why not use bin or lib directory DLL files by default #25351
    Discussion
  • FATAL_GC_ERROR in SVR::gc_heap::sort_mark_list (gc.cpp:10804): region_limit == NULL — mark list contains an address outside any region (regions, Server GC, .NET 10.0.11) #55784

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/11.0.1xx-rc1] Package download: Validate paths on non-Windows platforms #55812
    backport
  • Let the build-failure analyst push fixes it cannot suggest inline #55807
  • Fix dotnetup prerelease channel branding #55802
  • Eliminate Native AOT warnings from MSBuild-backed CLI commands #55801
  • Suppress optional workload notices with `dotnet new --no-update-check` #55800

Merged

  • Package download: Validate paths on non-Windows platforms #55810
  • Recognize roslyn telemetry #55572
    Area-Telemetry
  • [wasm] Support browser-wasm/wasi-wasm ReadyToRun in ResolveReadyToRunCompilers #55785
    arch-wasm

Updated

  • Fix Linux HTTP gateway wrong-path test flake #55790
  • Show dotnetup environment setup progress after installation #55796
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55754
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55735
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.4.0-preview.26409.6 to 4.4.0-preview.26411.1 #55768
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Bump Microsoft.WixToolset.Sdk from 6.0.3-dotnet.6 to 6.0.3-dotnet.14 #55767
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Preserve whitespace-path throw in StaticWebAsset.NormalizeContentRootPath #54868
    stale
  • File-level directives: allow quoting and additional properties #55592
    Area-run-file
  • Enable MSBuild-backed commands in the Native AOT CLI #55497
  • Stop build-failure-analysis workflows from filing a public detection-runs issue #55771
